_comment: Single source of truth for the models this worker needs.
Every entry is converted from the ORIGINAL Qwen repository (Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1)
into the single-file, ComfyUI-named checkpoint that ComfyUI can load. The sources
are diffusers-format shards; 'convert' describes how they are turned into one file
(see src/safetensors_convert.py). Nothing is recomputed - keys are renamed, tensors
are copied (and concatenated for ComfyUI's fused SwiGLU FFN), so the weights are the
'expect' is what the OUTPUT must look like: tensor count, dtype, tensor bytes and a
sha256 of the sorted 'key|shape' listing. The conversion is refused unless it matches,
so no exact offsets or raw weights are stored in this repository.
'output_bytes' drives the free-space preflight; 'bake' is unused here (the models are
built on the worker's first start, from the RunPod model cache or Hugging Face).
Cold start: set the endpoint's cached model to Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1. RunPod then stages
the whole repo in the host's local HF cache, and src/ensure_models.py reads the shards
from there in place - no download, and no second copy of the 33 GB.

models.name: qwen_image_2.1_bf16.safetensors
models.provenance: ComfyUI's qwen_image21 FFN is a fused SwiGLU (img_mlp.gate_up + img_mlp.out); the original repo ships img_mlp.gate_layer + img_mlp.proj, which are the two halves in row order. Concatenating them was verified byte-identical to Comfy-Org's repackage for blocks 0, 5 and 31 (spanning both shards).

models.name: qwen3vl_8b_bf16.safetensors
models.provenance: The original wraps the language tower as model.language_model.*; ComfyUI's Qwen3-VL loader wants model.*. The rename maps the 750-key source set onto the loader's key set exactly (no keys added, dropped or reshaped).

models.name: qwen_image_2.1_vae_fp32.safetensors
models.provenance: ComfyUI loads this VAE as a WanVAE (comfy.ldm.wan.vae2_2, temporal kernel 1, RGBA out), which uses the middle/upsamples/downsamples/head/residual naming and 5D kernels. The original is the same tensors in diffusers naming as 4D (image) kernels. Mapping verified by value on 14 key families: every source element is within 1 ULP of Comfy-Org's bf16 conversion, which is what a bf16 rounding of the fp32 original looks like. Kept in fp32 (the upstream precision), so it is 1.35 GB instead of 0.68 GB.
